blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A passenger jeepney overturned after its brakes allegedly failed while traversing a downhill road in Infanta, Quezon, on Saturday, Oct. 24, injuring the driver and 15 passengers bound for a picnic. In a report on Sunday, Quezon police said the jeepney was negotiating a downhill stretch in Barangay Magsaysay at around 6:30 a.m. when the driver allegedly lost control of the vehicle due to faulty brakes. The jeepney crashed into concrete barriers before overturning with all 32 passengers aboard.
